fields.description: 'Main' is the image Amazon shows in search results — the variant's own photo, on a plain white background. 'Gallery' images follow it in order. Approval publishes the rows in this order, main first, so changing a role here changes what the shopper sees first.
fields.label: Role

fields.description: What this image is, in the image step's own vocabulary (e.g. 'enhanced' for a retouched photo, 'translated' for a reworked supplier photo).
fields.label: Kind

fields.description: The input photo this image was derived from, when there was one.
fields.label: Source URL

fields.description: The resulting image. Empty when it could not be produced — see Note.
fields.label: URL

fields.description: The instruction used to produce this image, for image steps that record one.
fields.label: Brief
